title: Hexcrow
summary: Milestone escrow with confidential invoice amounts, approval, timeout refunds and jointly signed mediator paths. November 5 review found a public replay of the creator’s November 4 run on the reset Esmeralda network, replacing the earlier waiting-for-test-funds state. The creator reports four invoices and ten refused attacks using the same v4 rules, ootle-rs 0.31 and tari_template_lib 0.37. The public invoice book exposes hashes, one-time keys, deadlines and status; client and accountant copies show invoice details. The recording switches those public replay views without a wallet or new transaction. Mediator judgment remains trusted; fees and timing remain visible. The browser reads an indexer without verifying its proofs, and demo throwaway keys must not hold value. The October 29 run and prior recordings remain historical evidence.
cardSummary: Replay confidential milestone invoices from public, client, contractor, mediator and accountant views to see who can read each detail.
